description: Fetch a web page or API through a RoamProxy residential (or datacenter/mobile) IP in the chosen country/city. Returns HTTP status and the body as markdown (default), plain text or raw HTML. Traffic is billed to the user's RoamProxy wallet.

city.description: City name, e.g. 'Los Angeles'. Requires country and state. If the city has no stock the gateway falls back to the state, then the country; check_ip shows where you landed.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. 'us', 'de', 'jp'. Omit for any country.

format.description: How to return HTML pages. Default markdown.

max_chars.description: Truncate the body to this many characters. Default 20000.

session.description: Sticky session id (letters/digits). Same id = same exit IP for a while. Omit to rotate the IP on every request.

state.description: State/region code, e.g. 'ca', 'ny', 'tx' (US full names like 'California' are also accepted). Requires country.

name: fetch_url
title: Fetch a URL through a RoamProxy IP
